title: Pure Mimighoul
summary: Pure Mimighoul Flip-control and burn deck, utilizing generic staples and Rank 1 payoffs. The archetype summons Level 1 mimic chests to the opponent's field in face-down Defense Position, forcing them open with Mimighoul Master, Room, and Maker so their backfiring effects trigger before transferring control back to your field to build Rank 1 Xyz bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Mimighoul Dungeon prevents opponent summons from attacking while anyone controls a face-down monster, searches any Mimighoul monster once per turn, and boosts non-Flip Mimighouls by their original DEF.

Mimighoul Maker reveals two Mimighoul Flip monsters from Deck; your opponent randomly summons one face-down to their field and you add the other to hand, then you can Special Summon a Mimighoul from hand.
Mimighoul Master searches any Mimighoul monster on Normal or Special Summon, and flips any face-down monster face-up as a Quick Effect.
One for One discards a monster to Special Summon Mimighoul Dragon or Mimighoul Archfiend directly from the Deck.
Terraforming adds Mimighoul Dungeon directly from Deck to hand to start the lock immediately.

summary.title: Opening: Mimighoul Dungeon + Mimighoul Maker
steps: Activate Mimighoul Dungeon (searched via Terraforming if needed) and use its ignition effect to search Mimighoul Master from your Deck.
Activate Mimighoul Maker, revealing Mimighoul Dragon and Mimighoul Archfiend; your opponent randomly summons one face-down to their field while you add the other to your hand.
Special Summon Mimighoul Master from hand with Maker's follow-up effect, triggering Master on summon to search Mimighoul Room from your Deck.
Activate Master's Quick Effect to flip the opponent's face-down Mimighoul chest face-up; its mandatory Flip effect resolves to disrupt the opponent and returns control to your field.
Overlay the returned Level 1 chest and a summoned chest into Giant Mimighoul or Mimighoul Throne.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Giant Mimighoul is a Rank 1 Rock that searches any Mimighoul card on summon, lets non-Xyz Mimighouls attack directly while the opponent controls a face-down monster, and destroys face-up cards up to the number of face-down monsters.
Mimighoul Throne is a Rank 1 Rock that detaches a material to Special Summon Mimighoul Master from hand, Deck, or GY, or equips Master to itself to bounce cards on the field.
Mimighoul Master cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects while you control another Mimighoul or any face-down monster exists, and reaches 4600 ATK under Mimighoul Dungeon.
Lyrilusc - Assembled Nightingale attacks directly to stack into Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder after combat.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Mimighoul Dungeon provides a continuous attack lock on opponent summons while face-down monsters exist, searches every turn, and provides massive DEF-to-ATK stat boosts.
Mimighoul Room Special Summons a Mimighoul monster from hand or Deck face-down to either field, then immediately flips a face-down monster face-up.
Mimighoul Fork forces the opponent to flip a face-down monster face-up or send it to the GY while letting you draw two cards.
Mimighoul Charm banishes and steals cards from your opponent's Extra Deck whenever a Mimighoul is flipped face-up during the Main Phase.
Triple Tactics Thrust is easily activated on Turn 1 when an opponent's mandatory Flip effect resolves on their field during your turn, Setting a Normal Spell/Trap from the Deck.

allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches the essential Mimighoul Dungeon Field Spell.
allow.One for One: Limited to 1 in TCG: discards 1 monster to Special Summon Level 1 Mimighoul Archfiend or Mimighoul Dragon directly from your Deck.
allow.Triple Tactics Thrust: Turns on after any opposing monster effect, which the Mimighoul Flip effects hand the opponent on your own turn. Replaces Triple Tactics Talent, Forbidden since October 2026.
allow.Lyrilusc - Assembled Nightingale: Rank 1 Xyz made with Level 1 Mimighouls that attacks directly to stack into Zeus.
allow.Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder: Rank 12 Xyz stacked over Giant Mimighoul or Mimighoul Throne after combat.

main: Mimighoul Dragon

Level 1 EARTH Dragon Flip: Special Summons itself to the opponent's field face-down; searches ANY 'Mimighoul' Spell/Trap on summon to your field; when flipped on opponent's field, destroys all non-Mimighoul monsters they control and returns to you!
Mimighoul Archfiend

Level 1 EARTH Fiend Flip: Special Summons itself to the opponent's field face-down; flips 1 face-down monster face-up during your Main Phase; when flipped on opponent's field, draws 1 card, discards 1 card from opponent's hand, and returns to you!
Mimighoul Fairy

Level 1 EARTH Fairy Flip: Special Summons itself to the opponent's field face-down; when flipped on opponent's field, locks opponent out of activating hand monster effects for the turn and returns to you!
Mimighoul Master

Signature Level 4 EARTH Zombie boss (1800 ATK / 2800 DEF -> 4600 ATK under Dungeon!): searches ANY Mimighoul monster on summon, cannot be destroyed while you control another Mimighoul or any face-down monster is on field, and flips 1 face-down monster as a Quick Effect!
Mimighoul Armor
Level 1 EARTH Warrior Flip: Special Summons itself to the opponent's field face-down; returns control to you when flipped and makes your Mimighouls indestructible by battle.
Mimighoul Slime

Level 1 EARTH Aqua Flip: Special Summons itself to the opponent's field face-down; when flipped on opponent's field, lets YOU Special Summon 1 'Mimighoul' monster directly from your Deck and returns to you!
Mimighoul Cerberus
Level 1 EARTH Beast Flip: banishes top 3 cards of your Deck when flipped to summon a banished monster to your field, returns to you, and makes your Mimighouls untargetable.
Mimighoul Dungeon

Core Field Spell: monsters your opponent summons cannot attack while anyone controls a face-down monster; searches any Mimighoul monster once per turn; and boosts non-Flip Mimighouls by their original DEF!
Mimighoul Maker
Core Normal Spell: reveals 2 Flip monsters from Deck—opponent randomly summons 1 to their field face-down while you add the other to hand, then you can summon 1 Mimighoul from hand.
Mimighoul Fork
Normal Spell: targets 1 face-down monster your opponent controls; opponent must either flip it face-up or send it to GY and let you draw 2 cards!
Mimighoul Charm
Continuous Spell that rips and steals cards from your opponent's Extra Deck whenever a Mimighoul is flipped face-up during the Main Phase!
Mimighoul Room
Signature Normal Trap: Special Summons 1 Mimighoul monster from hand or Deck to either field face-down, then flips 1 face-down monster on the field face-up.
Triple Tactics Thrust
Once the opponent's mandatory Flip effect resolves during your turn: Sets a Normal Spell/Trap from the Deck, or adds it if they control a monster.
One for One
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Mimighoul Dragon or Archfiend from the Deck.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Mimighoul Dungeon.
